name: Tax Withholding Method 3 Code
definition: Specifies the method by which the tax on the interests is to be processed i.e. either withheld at source or reported to tax authorities or a tax certificate has been provided by the beneficiary.

INVE.name: Investment Company
INVE.definition: Withholding tax is applied to an investment company.

ACCT.name: Accountant
ACCT.definition: Dividend tax is exempt according to the accountant.

REPT.name: Report Tax
REPT.definition: Tax information is reported to the tax authorities and therefore not withheld at source.

CRTF.name: Tax Certificate
CRTF.definition: Tax certificate is provided by the beneficiary from its tax authority in its country of residence. Therefore, the obligation of withholding tax is waived and tax information will be reported to the tax authorities.

WHCO.name: Withholding Corporate Tax
WHCO.definition: Withholding tax is applied to a corporate.

WTRE.name: Withhold Tax And Report
WTRE.definition: Tax is withheld at source and the tax information is also reported to the tax authorities.
